title: Table 2.7 Building separation within site boundary
notes: Application 'All R-Codes', within site boundary: 3 m up to 4 storeys, 6 m at 5 storeys and above. No room-type distinction; measured from the outer face of the building envelope including balconies (Figure 2.7a). Volume 2 required 12/18/24 m between habitable rooms (C4P2-074).
